notes.title: Journey of the Forgotten - 1-YEAR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE
notes.content:
Campaign now includes emotional images. The new mount "Shadow Crystal" is now accessible for players who have completed "The Four Crystals". [Quest starts in Wentora]

Fixes/Patches:
- A plant in the new area was displayed incorrectly as a pillar instead
- Fixed a minor bug concerning the flying demon (only in combination with the new area)
- Minor translation fix in JP (Japanese) version
- Emotion changes in the full campaign and boss dialogues
- Added mount to stable, can be accessed from there after completing the quest
- New mount also working with all characters and tested [+reduces encounters]

Please enjoy. Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Update 1.6.1.0
notes.content:
Changes in 1.6.1.0:

[list]
[*] More pointers towards Quia's desk were added. You can always look up controls there.
[*] In addition, there is a controls option in menu now, which also shows mapping for the Steam Controller.
[*] Character pictures were added.
[/list]

Next patch will force me to rework a lot of the existing story content but it will be only visual changes.
So you can play it without missing out or being affected.

Thank you for reading and have a great time.

notes.title: Patch and Information regarding Riding
notes.content:
Quality of Life Update 1.6.0.3 is live.

The horse for the player can be obtained going north at the start.

You do not need to be a master of martial arts or reach lvl 60 to use horses and it will help reducing encounters early on.

For people who think moving does not feel like moving, sprint is available (yes, even while riding).

Basic controls can be viewed in Quia's notebook in her room.

notes.title: Big REWORK and Version 1.5 Changes
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44660319/3da5e97dc99a3e2dc733e7ed8fd44087fb28ea9f.png[/img]

Starting 2024 Journey of the Forgotten received major updates and had its DEMO go live. If you have not seen it yet, check out the new version.

The game received the following improvements:
- new Key Art reflecting game elements more clearly
- new Steam Page better covering the extent of the project
- better screenshots, reworked trailer
- improved tilesets of the entire game
- improved sprites of monsters/enemies
- improved UI and the player is allowed to adapt via "Window Flair"
- improved music and more special pieces all over the game
- "Music Room" with unlockable music pieces from the game
- "Pictures" which works like an Art Gallery and unlocks pictures for achievements
- fixes/patches for small graphical issues and a missing translation
- 3 new bosses for the "endgame" (of the current content)

Journey of the Forgotten is participating in the Steam Next Fest February (5th - 12th).

For Press: There is a Next Fest Pre-Release Event for Press on the 25th

For Players: TwoSoulFox Studios is streaming during these time slots
TWOSOULFOX STREAM #1    _6th 6:00 CET (12th 21:00 PST)
TWOSOULFOX STREAM #2    12th 6:00 CET (11th 21:00 PST)

Enjoy the game and have a great time!
